༄༅/ /ku ru kul+le sngon mo'i char 'bebs dang sad bsrung gi yi ge bklag chog ma 'gro la dge ba'i lhag bsam bsil zer bzhugs so/ /oṃ swasti sid+dha

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /ku ru kul+le sngon mo'i char 'bebs dang sad bsrung gi yi ge bklag chog ma 'gro la dge ba'i lhag bsam bsil zer bzhugs so// oṃ swasti sid+dhaṃ/ bcom ldan 'das kyis 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs la gsungs pa'i char dbab dang / sad bsrung ba'i gdam par byed pa 'dod na pad+ma rak+ta sha ba dang sre mong gi khrag bzang drug la sogs klu sman gang 'dzoms dang / bag zan rnams bsres pa'i ril bu mang du byas te 'phrod nad gung zhag lnga sngags bzlas/ gro ga sogs la 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad mu khyud dang bcas pa bris/ de'i lte bar srog shing drangs/ mu khyud nang mar dbu nang bstan la oṃ shar shar phroṃ phroṃ nā ga rā dza sprin myur du bsdus drag tu bsdus shigs bha ri sha ya bha ri sha ya/ sprin drag tu bsdus shig sprin drag tu ma bsdus na thub pa chen po'i bka'i chad pa 'ong ngo / /zhes gzab yig tu bris/ rtsibs brgyad du thub pa re re'i rgyab tu oṃ āḥhūm̐ bri/ thugs kar oṃ mu ne mu ne ma hā mu ne ye swāhā/ rtsibs chen brgyad du/ oṃ ku ru kul+le hrīḥphu phu sa le sa le phuḥ nā ga sa le phuḥ ka la ka le phuḥ klu'i rgyal po rgyal mo rnams kyis 'dzam bu'i gling 'dir sprin myur du bsdus/ drag tu bsdus shig ces bri/ phyi'i mu khyud la ye dharmā bri/ 'khor lo'i rgyab ngos su pad+ma 'dab brgyad bris pa'i mu khyud nang mar yig mgo phyir bstan la/ oṃ shar shar sogs bris/ 'dab ma brgyad du klu chen brgyad stod mi la smad sbrul du 'khyil ba/ snying khar thal mo sbyar ba/ sbrul mgo brgyad pa nas gcig pa'i bar gyi gdengs ka can bris te/ de'i snying kar phuḥre re bris/ gong ras la oṃ ku ru kul+le sogs bri/ mu khyud la ye dharmā bri/ de nas chu mig gnyen por mchod gtor phul la/ chu mig mgor shing leb la pad+ma 'dab brgyad bris pa'i lte bar 'khor lo'i srog shing drangs/

rtsa ba la chu skor gdags/ nang du rdzas kyi ril bu bzhag rtse mo 'khor lo'i thub pa yar bstan la ras sam dar sngon po dgab ste/ g.yas su bskor/ 'og gi pad 'dab brgyad du phuḥre re bris pa'i steng du klu gzugs re re gzhag phyogs bzhir ba dan sngon po re re 'dzugs/ mtha' rtsi shing gi bskor ba/ steng du char khebs gur sngon po phub/ de nas skad cig gi rang nyid ku ru kul+le sku mdog sngon mo zhal gcig phyag bzhi ma/ dang po gnyis mda' gzhu 'gengs pa/ g.yas kyi 'og mas lcags kyus klu thams cad kyi snying kar nas bzung ba/ g.yon gyi 'og mas zhags pas sprin bsdus shing sde brgyad bcings par bsam/ mdun gyi pad+ma steng 'og gnyis sprin nag gi pad+ma kha sbyor gyi nang bsrung rigs thams cad chud pa'i steng du klu'i sprin thams cad bsdus par bsam/ gzugs la bstim par bya/ 'khor lo'i steng gi thub pa brgyad kyi sde brgyad la/ sad bsrung bar bka' bsgos par bsam zhing / mtshan mo oṃ ku ru kul+le hrīḥphuḥl sogs pa ci nus bzla'o/ /sprin bsdus ces pa'i dod du char phob ces bri'o/ /dkon mchog gsum dang bsrung ma sde brgyad klu dang gzhi bdag dang bcas pa la mchod pa dbul/ gsol ba gdab/ bka' bsgo drag tu bya'o// ༈ /na mo gu ru ār+ya tā ra ye/ rje btsun sa skya pa'i khyad par gyi gdam pa dmar po bskor gsum las rje btsun rig byed ma'i chos bskor gyi nang tshan ku ru kul+le sngon mo'i sgo nas char 'bebs dang / sad bsrung gi gdams pa la sbyor dngos rjes gsum las/ sbyor ba ni gong du bshad pa'i yi ge rnying ma nyid sor bzhag la char 'bebs byed ran gyi zhag gnyis gsum gyi sngon du char rdzas ril bu tho rangs dmar skyur la sgog sogs kyi dri ma med pa'i kha chus dag par dkrus la/ oṃ shar shar sogs kyi sngags la/ sprin myur du bsdus sogs spel tshig yod pa rnams/

char myur du phob/ bzang bar phob/ yun bsrings te ran pa phob/ char ma phabs na thub pa chen po'i bka'i chad pa 'ong ngo / /zhes pa bsgyur/ sad bsrung na 'khor lo'i ril bu dbyung la sprin sdud kyi sngags gzhung bzhin bzlas la tshom ma ma thor ba phus btab/ phyogs bzhi ba dan sngon po'i mthar chu gnyis sngon 'gro'i nyer spyod mtshams 'dzin gyi me tog bcas g.yas bskor gyi mthar rtsi shing gi bskor ba/ chab klu'i chas rang gi mdun du rdor dril 'thor nas maṇ+ḍal tshom bu so bdun ma'am/ bdun ma gang rung gos zung rnams bsham mo/ /dngos gzhi ni thog mar 'khor lo gang du 'jug pa'i chu mig der klu thebs bsam/ thebs med bzlog med kyi nyin chab klu 'jam mgon a mes zhabs sogs kyi gsung rabs nas 'byung ba bzhin btang la gong bcas bshams rnams bgyis te/ rang nyid stan bde ba la 'khod nas yul phyogs des mtshon sems can thams cad la byams snying rje byang chub kyi sems nan tan tu bsgom ste ngag tu bdag dang 'gro ba khams gsum nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad dus da nas bzung ste ji srid byang chub snying po la mchis kyi bar du dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams la skyabs su mchi'o/ /rdzogs pa'i༞ dam pa'i༞ 'phags pa'i༞ nyer gcig sogs ci 'grub/ bla ma dang dkon mchog rin po che rnam pa gsum la bdag phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su mchi'o/ /khyed rnams kyi bdag gi brgyud byin gyi brlab tu gsol/ sems can thams cad kyi don du rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phangs thob par bya/ de'i ched du rje btsun ma ku ru kul+le'i bsgom bzlas nyams su blangs bar bgyi'o/ /lan gsum/ sems can thams cad bde ba dang sogs tshad med bzhi bsgom/ rang gi snying kha nas 'od zer 'phros pas rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma yi dam dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs sangs rgyas byang sems nyan thos rang rgyal chos bsrung nor lha sde brgyad klu dang gzhi bdag thams cad oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ

mdun gyi nam mkhar bar snang sa gzhi thams cad gang ba'i tshul du bzhugs par gyur/ sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i sku/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa'i ngo bo nyid/ /dkon mchog gsum gyi rtsa ba ste/ /bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /mkhyen brtse nus pa'i ngo bo nyid/ /sgrub la dngos grub mchog rtsol ba/ /yi dam lha la phyag 'tshal lo/ /ston pa bla med sangs rgyas rin po che/ /skyob pa bla med dam chos rin po che/ /'dren pa bla med dge 'dun rin po che/ /bla med dkon mchog gsum la༞ /mkha' ltar khyab pa'i rgyal ba sras bcas la/ /bdag dang mkha' mnyam 'gro ba ma lus pa'i/ /lus 'di zhing rdul mnyam par rab sprul nas/ /rtag tu gus pa'i yid kyis༞ /phyag byar 'os pa thams cad la/ /zhing rdul kun gyi grangs snyed kyi/ /lus btud pa yi rnam kun tu/ /mchog tu dad pas phyag 'tshal lo/ /mchod pa rnams/ oṃ a mṛ ta hūm̐ phaṭa kyis bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las oṃ las byung ba'i rin po che las grub pa'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du oṃ 'od du zhu ba las byung ba'i lha rdzas las grub pa'i mchod yon/ zhabs bsil/ me tog bdug spos/ mar me/ dri mchog zhal zas/ rol mo rnams dwangs shing thogs pa med pa nam mkha'i mtha' klas par gyur/ zhes dang so so'i phyag rgya bcas la/ oṃ badz+ra a swāhā/ oṃ badz+ra pā d+yaṃ/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe/ oṃ badz+ra dhū pe/ oṃ badz+ra ā lo ke oṃ badz+ra gan+dhe/ oṃ badz+ra nai wi d+yaṃ/ oṃ badz+ra shap+ta āḥhūm̐/ zhes pas byin gyis brlabs/ mchod yon phal cher mchod yon bla bre dang / /mchod yon bkod pa'i 'od zer rab rgyas te/ /mchod yon sna tshogs kun tu bkram byas nas/ /bdag nyid chen po'i rgyal ba sras bcas mchod/ /oṃ gu ru bud+dha bo dhi sa twa sa pa ri wā ra a pra tīts+tsha pū dza me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra na sa ma ye hūm̐/ zhes sogs so so'i phyag rgya dang bcas pas/

zhabs bsil༞ zhabs bsil༞ zhabs bsil༞ bdag nyid༞ oṃ gu ru༞ sogs nas/ pā d+yaṃ sogs 'don pa bsgyur la/ me tog༞ me tog༞ me tog༞ bdag nyid༞ pūṣ+pe༞ bdug spos༞ bdug spos༞ bdug spos༞ bdag nyid༞ dhū pe༞ snang gsal༞ snang gsal༞ snang gsal༞ bdag nyid༞ a lo ke༞ dri mchog༞ dri mchog༞ dri mchog༞ bdag nyid༞ gan+dhe༞ zhal zas༞ zhal zas༞ zhal zas༞ bdag nyid༞ nai wi d+yaṃ༞ rol mo༞ rol mo༞ rol mo༞ bdag nyid༞ shap+ta༞ dharmā ra ṇi༞ rol mo sogs dbul lo/ /nam mkha' mdzod kyi phyag rgya dang bcas/ oṃ sarba bid pū ra pū ra/ su ra su ra a warta ya/ at+ta ya hoḥ zhes brjod cing / thal mo snying khar sbyar la/ bde bar gshegs pa thams cad la/ /'khor lo rin chen 'di 'bul bas/ /srid pa'i 'khor lo rgyun bcad de/ /chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar shog /oṃ gu ru bud+dha bo dhi satwa sa pa ri wā ra tsakra rat+na pū dzī te hūm̐/ ces dang / rgyal ba sras dang bcas rnams la/ /nor bu rin chen༞ /bkres cing phongs par rgyun chad nas/ /'byor pa phun sum tshogs par shog /rigs 'gre sbyar la/ ma ṇi rat+na༞ btsun mo rin chen༞ /ma rig mun pa rgyun chad nas/ /shes rab dbyings kyi don rtogs ste/ /thabs dang shes rab 'brel bar shog /wasti rat+na༞ blon po rin chen༞ /phyi nang gsang gsum theg gsum ldan/ /bsam yas bstan pa legs 'dzin cing / /yon tan thams cad 'dzin par shog /ma hā ta rat+na༞ glang po rin chen༞ /ltas ngan rnams ni rab bsal nas/ /bla med theg pa rab bzhon nas/ /thams cad mkhyen grong sgrod par shog /hasti rat+na༞ rta mchog rin chen༞ /srid pa'i gzeb las nges grol te/ /rdzu 'phrul mchog gi shugs thob nas/ /sangs rgyas zhing du 'gro bar shog /tu raṅgha a shwa rat+na༞ dmag dpon rin chen༞ /nyon mongs dgra las rgyal gyur te/ /phas kyi rgol ba tshar bcad nas/ /snyan grags mchog ldan thob par shog /khaṅga rat+na༞ ces dang / kha dog dbyibs legs yid 'ong rgyan phreng ldan/

/phyogs dus kun na gzugs mchog ci mchis pa/ /mos blos dkyil 'khor lha la bdag 'bul gyi/ /bzhes shig bla med grub mchog stsal du gsol/ /oṃ gu ru bud+dha bo dhi satwa sa pa ri wa ra rū pa ka ma gu na pū dzī te hūm̐/ ces dang / phyogs dus kun na zin dang mi zin pa'i/ /yon tan tshim mchog sgra snyan ci mchis rnams/ /mos༞ /bzhes shig༞ /gong bzhin thog mtha' 'dra ba las/ rū pa'i gnas su/ shap+ta sogs sbyar la/ phyogs dus kun na tsan+dan sbrul snying dang / /a dkar nag sogs dbang po tshims byed rnams/ /mos blos༞ /bzhes shig༞ /gan+dhe༞ phyogs dus kun na ro dang bcud ldan pa'i/ /lus sems bltas byed ro mchog ci mchis rnams/ /mos blos༞ /bzhes༞ /rā sa༞ phyogs dus kun na 'jam mnyen 'khril chags pa'i/ /reg bya'i khyad par lus sems tshim byed rnams/ /mos༞ /bzhes༞ /par+ṣe༞ ces pas gos zung 'bul/ oṃ badz+ra bhu mi āḥhūm̐/ gzhi yongs su dag pa dbang chen gser gyi sa gzhi'i steng du/ oṃ badz+ra re ṣe āḥhūm̐/ phyi lcags ri khor yug gis bskor ba'i dbus su hūm̐/ ri'i rgyal po ri rab/ shar lus 'phags po/ lho 'dzam bu gling / nub ba lang spyod/ byang sgra mi snyan/ lus dang lus 'phags/ rnga yab dang rnga yab gzhan/ g.yo ldan dang lam mchog 'gro/ sgra mi snyan dang sgra mi snyan gyi zla/ rin po che'i ri bo/ dpag bsam gyi shing / 'dod 'jo'i ba/ ma rmos pa'i lo tog 'khor lo rin po che/ nor bu rin po che/ btsun mo rin po che/ blon po rin po che/ glang po rin po che/ rta mchog rin po che/ dmag dpon rin po che/ gter chen po'i bum pa/ sgeg mo ma/ phreng ba ma/ glu ma/ gar ma/ bdug spos ma/ me tog ma/ mar me ma/ dri chab ma/ nyi ma/ zla ba/ rin po che'i gdugs/ phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba'i rgyal mtshan/ lha dang mi yi dpal 'byor phun sum tshogs pa ma tshang ba med pa 'di nyid drin chen rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams dang /

yi dam dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs dang bcas pa rnams la dbul bar bgyi'o/ /thugs rjes 'gro ba'i don du bzhes su gsol/ bzhes nas byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ /gang gi mchod rdzas zhing khams rgya mtsho rgya mtsho'i rdul snyed sna tshogs mchod pa'i sprin phung gi /rnam par brgyan pa'i rgyan gyi 'od zer phyogs bcur 'phro ba'i 'od kyi rtse mo rgya mtsho yis/ /rdul gyi grangs snyed rin chen pad+mo rin chen 'od 'byin kun nas rgyas pa'i snying po la/ /lha dang mi yi 'dod yon rmad 'di 'dod dgu'i dpal 'byung bye ba phrag brgya legs gnas pa/ /kun tu bzang po'i rnam 'phrul ji bzhin kun nas dge ba'i sems kyis sprul pa'i mchod sprin 'di/ /chos dbyings ji bzhin nam mkha'i dbyings kun kun la khyab cing sems can dbyings mtha' ji srid bar/ /rnam par gnas nas chos kyi rgyal po rgyal ba rgyal sras rang rgyal dgra las rnam rgyal bas/ /kun nas bskor ba'i dkyil 'khor kun tu rnam par mchod pa'i mchod pa kun gyi mnyes gyur cig /deng nas byang chub snying po'i bar/ /bdag gi lus dang longs spyod dang / /dus gsum dge ba'i dngos po rnams/ /sems can kun gyi don gyi phyir/ /gus pas khyed la dbul bar bgyi/ /kun nas gzigs pa'i spyan ldan pa/ /yon gnas dam pa khyed rnams kyis/ /bdag la brtse bas nyer dgongs te/ /bdag gi 'di dag bzhes su gsol/ /bzhes nas byin gyi brlabs tu gsol/ /oṃ gu ru bud+dha bo dhi satwa sa pa ri wā ra maṇ+ḍa la pū dzā me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ye hūm̐/ smin grol bdud rtsi'i char rgyun gyi/ /bdag sogs gdul bya rjes 'dzin pa'i/ /rtsa brgyud bla mar gsol bar 'debs/ /byin brlabs char rgyun myur du stsol/ /gang la brten na mchog thun gyis/ /dngos grub 'bad med stsol mdzad pa'i/ /yi dam tshogs la gsol ba 'debs/

/dngos grub char rgyun myur du stsol/ /nam yang bslu ba mi mnga' ba'i/ /mchog gsum rgyal ba sras bcas la/ /rtse gcig gus pas gsol ba 'debs/ /'dod dgu'i char chen myur du stsol/ /bstan dang 'jig rten legs skyong zhing / /bar chad kun sel dpal 'byor stsol/ /chos srung nor lhar gsol ba 'debs/ /dbul sel char rgyun myur du stsol/ /mnyam med shākya'i rgyal po sogs/ /rgyal dang rgyal sras bka' bsgos ltar/ /lha srin sde brgyad thams cad dang / /khyad par klu dang gzhi bdag gis/ /yul phyogs 'dis mtshon rgyal khams kyi/ /'gro ba bde skyid 'byung ba'i phyir/ /mthun pa'i rlung dang sprin bsdus la/ /zim char dal gyi 'babs pa'i rgyun/ /ri klung kun tu myur du phob/ /'bru dang 'bras bu rtswa la sogs/ /mi phyugs kun gyi gsos gyur pa'i/ /longs spyod rnams kyi bcud dang g.yang / /ma lus 'phel zhing rgyas gyur nas/ /mu ge'i ming yang mi grag cing / /dpal 'byor nam mkha' mdzod bzhin stsol/ /dkon mchog gsum gyi bka' 'di dang / /bdag gi lhag bsam dag pa las/ /gal te khyed kyi 'das gyur na/ /sras bcas rgyal ba'i bka' bcad kyis/ /myur du 'jigs pa gdon mi za/ /de bas bcol pa'i phrin las 'di/ /da lta nyid du sgrub par mdzod/ /zhes lan gsum la sogs pa brjod la/ oṃ swa bhā was sbyangs/ bdag mdun gnyis mi dmigs te stong par gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las rang nyid skad cig gi pad+ma nyi ma mi ro dmar ser mgo g.yon du bstan pa'i steng du/ ku ru kul+le sku mdog sngon mo zhal gcig phyag bzhi ma/ dang po gnyis mda' gzhu 'gengs pa/ g.yas kyi 'og mas lcags kyus klu thams cad kyi snying khar nas bzung ba/ g.yon gyi 'og mas zhags pas sprin bsdus shing sde brgyad bcings pa/ zhal mche ba'i myu gu cung zad gzigs shing 'dzum khro'i rnam par can/ spyan gsum dang ldan pa/ nu 'bur zung gis mdzes shing /

lang tsho lo bcu drug lon pa lta bu dbu skra kham pa gyen du brdzes pa/ rigs lnga'i rang bzhin can gyi thod pa skam po lngas dbu rgyan zhing rlon pa lnga bcus do shal can/ rus pa'i rgyan cha lngas brgyan pa/ stag gi lpags pa'i sham thabs gsol ba/ mi ro dmar ser mgo g.yon du bstan pa'i steng du zhabs g.yon brkyang gi brla la g.yas pa'i brang ba gtad pa'i skyil krung phyed pa'i gar gyi bzhugs pa/ mdun gyi pad+ma steng 'og gnyis sprin nag gi pad+ma kha sbyor gyi nang du yul phyogs 'di nyid gnas pa'i steng sprin chen brgyad la sogs pa klu'i sprin thams cad 'dus par gyur/ zhes dang hūm̐ mdzad kyis phyag rgya dang bcas la/ na mo rje btsun rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang / sangs rgyas༞ chos༞ dge 'dun༞ khyad par du yang mnyam med shākya'i rgyal po dang / rje btsun rig byed lha mo'i bka' bden pa dang / bden pa chen po'i byin rlabs kyi sprin chen po brgyad la sogs pa 'jig rten gyi khams kyi mthun zhing dge ba'i sprin thams cad skad cig thang cig yud tsam la 'dir mchis par gyur cig oṃ ḍāk+ki hūm̐ dzaḥ zhes dang mdzub mo gnyis bkug pa lan gsum la sogs par byas la/ de ltar sprin 'dus pa las char gyi rgyun bzang po chal chil du bab pas lo tog dang rtswa la sogs pa thams cad rdzogs ldan gyi dus bzhin legs par byed pa/ de'i steng du 'khor lo sngon po rtsibs brgyad pa'i rtsibs rnams la pad+ma dang zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du bdag cag gi ston pa mnyam med shākya'i rgyal po sku mdog gser btso ma lta bu zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yas sa gnon/ g.yon mnyam bzhag gi phyag rgya mdzad pa/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil mo krung gi bzhugs pa/ mtshan bzang po sum cu rtsa gnyis dang / dpe byad bzang po brgyad bcus spras pa/ ngur smrig gi bla gos dang thang gos gsol ba/

de rnams kyi lha srin sde brgyad klu dang gzhi bdag rnams la bka' bsgos pas char bzang po 'bad med lhun grub tu 'bebs par gyur/ zhes brjod cing bsgom la/ gong du bshad pa'i/ oṃ ku ru nas/ 'dzam bu'i gling 'dir bar/ char phob cig myur du phob cig ces spel tshig dang bcas pa'i sngags brgya stong la sogs par bzlas la/ bcom ldan 'das bdag dang sems can thams cad la dngos grub kyi bka' drin rgya chen po stsal du gsol/ zhes brjod/ rang gi dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par aḥ thugs khar hūm̐/ dge ba 'di yi myur du bdag /rig byed lha mo 'grub gyur nas/ /sogs dang / 'jig rten bde zhing sogs dang / lhas kyang dus su char 'bebs shing sogs dang / mkha' la glog phreng rgyu sogs dang / ri rnams rtswa sogs dang / yul phyogs kun tu sogs dang / sems can thams cad bde ba dang sogs dang / sems can 'di dag sogs dang / dge ba 'di yi skye bo kun sogs dang / bsod nams 'di yis thams cad sogs dang / sangs rgyas sku gsum sogs dang / bgegs rigs stong phrag brgyad cu zhi ba dang / /sogs bsngo smon bkra shis gang shes brjod pa las 'di dgos kyi nges pa ni med do/ /gal te rlung gi gtor na dwags po paṇa chen bkra shis rnam rgyal gyi rig byed ma'i chos bskor dngos grub 'byung ba kho bos gsal byed dang bcas pa bzhin rlung gnon bya zhing / ston ka sad bsrung na/ sbyor dngos rjes gsum gong dang 'dra ba las mi 'dra ba'i khyad par gong du bshad pa ltar/ 'khor lo'i nang du bcug pa'i ril bu 'phyung la sprin sdud kyi sngags gong gi yi ge rnying ma ltar bzlas phus zhag shes sgrub ste 'khor lo'i nang du bcug dngos gzhi'i gsol 'debs kyi char rgyun myur du stsol zhes pa thams cad/ sad kyi 'jigs pa srung du gsol/ zhes par bsgyur/ mthun pa'i rlung dang sprin bsdus la zhes pa'i rjes su/ sad kyi 'jigs pa kun bsrung zhing /
